# lib/lcd module

HD44780-compatible character LCD driver. This page is the reference for the `lib/lcd` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

| Fact | Value |

| Source | [`lib/lcd`](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/lcd) |

| Parts, PIC16F87XA | 16F877, 16F877A |
| Parts, PIC16F88X | 16F887 |

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family. Build it with the repository build driver, or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.
